description: This file defines the AgentFieldClient class for interacting with an agent management API, including methods for registration, heartbeat, execution, event publishing, capability discovery, and sending notes.

classes.name: AgentFieldClient
classes.description: A client class for communicating with agent-related API endpoints, managing registration, health checks, execution, event publishing, capability discovery, and note sending.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the AgentFieldClient with configuration, setting up base URL, headers, and Axios instance.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a node with the agent API using provided payload.

methods.name: heartbeat
methods.description: Sends a heartbeat signal with status to the agent API and returns the health status.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a target with input and optional metadata, returning the result.

methods.name: publishWorkflowEvent
methods.description: Publishes a workflow event with execution details; fire-and-forget, errors are caught silently.

methods.name: updateExecutionStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an execution with provided update details.

methods.name: discoverCapabilities
methods.description: Discovers capabilities based on options, returning structured discovery results.

methods.name: mapDiscoveryResponse
methods.description: Maps raw discovery payload to structured DiscoveryResponse.

methods.name: mapCompactDiscovery
methods.description: Maps raw compact discovery payload to structured CompactDiscoveryResponse.

methods.name: sanitizeHeaders
methods.description: Sanitizes headers by converting values to strings and removing undefined or null.

methods.name: mergeHeaders
methods.description: Merges default headers with additional headers, sanitizing the result.

methods.name: buildExecutionHeaders
methods.description: Builds headers for execution metadata, such as runId, sessionId, etc.

methods.name: sendNote
methods.description: Sends a note message to the UI API, fire-and-forget, errors are caught silently.
